title: vendor
summary: Benilla defines CMSG_LIST_INVENTORY/BUY_ITEM/SELL_ITEM/BUYBACK_ITEM/REPAIR_ITEM and the SMSG_LIST_INVENTORY/BUY_ITEM/SELL_ITEM/BUY_FAILED parses with the buy/sell result vocabularies. MSUI implements all five sends (incl. buyback's absolute slot 69-80 and repair's itemGuid==0 repair-all) and all four parses in Net/VendorState.cs + WorldSession.cs, wired to the merchant UI with buyback rendered from the PLAYER_VENDOR_BUYBACK descriptor fields as Benilla does.
